assets.name: shop
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one production-ready complete square mobile game HUD button for an aquarium game, closely following the classic Clash of Clans menu button visual style: chunky black outer outline, softly rounded square corners, thin cream inset bevel, glossy upper highlight, dark lower extruded edge, strong simplified cartoon silhouette, hand-painted 3D shading, readable at 64 pixels. Front-on square UI tile, NOT a scene or mockup. Button nearly fills square canvas with equal 3% transparent margin around all four edges. Genuine transparent alpha outside button, opaque button face, no checkerboard background. Shop: stacks of gold coins and a chunky builders hammer, ivory upper face and golden yellow lower face. Exact text "SHOP" in large white block cartoon letters with dark outline along bottom. Center illustration prominently inside frame. All artwork contained inside tile. Restrained detail, warm saturated colors, consistent top-left lighting. No watermark, no additional text. Deliver one square PNG.
